_comment: Jacques' MCP set, loaded with --mcp-config + --strict-mcp-config so it REPLACES the root
.mcp.json rather than merging. This is the only place GRAPHITI_GROUP_ID actually binds:
the root .mcp.json declares it as a LITERAL 'jarvis-core', and an env value declared in an
mcp server's config overrides the launching process's environment — so exporting
GRAPHITI_GROUP_ID in the launcher alone would silently do nothing and Jacques' entities would
land in the Master Archon's graph. Learned on the Genie install.
scholar-gateway is omitted: Jacques' domain is client task authoring, not literature search.
annas-archive likewise. Smaller tool surface, and one less place a tracked secret travels.
